cues.en: And the beautiful thing is, is we just tried to run that machine learning model and it told us, Hey, we can't it's not going to work because you've got non numbers in your data, you've got some strings
cues.zh: 好處是，我們試著執行模型，它就告訴我們：「不行，資料有非數字內容，」

cues.en: in your data and if we were to go again it might tell us eventually that we've got missing data.
cues.zh: 「包含一些字串。」如果繼續嘗試，之後也可能告訴我們有缺失資料。
